stocks.impact_theory: Cisco reported strong Q3 FY2026 earnings on May 13, beating estimates with revenue up 12% YoY to $15.8B driven by massive AI-related networking demand. Raised FY guidance. Amid Trump-Xi summit easing trade tensions, reinforces AI infrastructure buildout. Economic implications: accelerates capex cycle for hyperscalers. Market psych: shifts fear to greed on AI monetization. Historical: parallels Cisco's dominance in internet boom 1990s. Analogies: like laying highways for AI data centers (1), or power grids for EV surge (2).

news_impact_analysis.reasoning: Earnings beat + AI guidance + positive X sentiment + chip rally from summit. Web searches confirm premarket surge to 52w high; X upgrades reinforce.

potential_profit_risks.long_position: Buy for 10-15% upside in 1-2 weeks on AI momentum; target $65.
potential_profit_risks.short_position: Avoid or short above $65 if AI hype fades; potential 5% drop.
potential_profit_risks.key_risks: Macro slowdown cuts capex; competition from Arista; overvaluation if guidance misses.

stocks.justification: Clear earnings catalyst + aligning macro (summit) + high volume + analyst upgrades.

Analogies: like unlocking Middle East oil for US energy firms (1), or ending steel tariffs (2).

news_impact_analysis.reasoning: Multiple news on Huang's last-minute inclusion; chip stocks up; X buzz on AI melt-up; summit de-escalation on trade.

potential_profit_risks.short_position: Short on overbought RSI if summit disappoints; 5-7% downside.
